Name: MALE CLOTHING - Bonestealer Pack - Outfit Presets FS - Fashion Sence
Author: marmuruah
Description:
This mod allows you to dress up your farmer as characters from[b] Bonestealer[/b] using [b]Fashion Sense[/b].[b] [/b]For convenience, the pack includes presets for 4* complete outfits, but you are free to mix and match individual clothing pieces to create your own combinations if you wish. It also includes a few skin tone variations, so you may find it useful even if you're not familiar with the comic. I'm sorry there aren't more skin tone options. Including every possible skin tone would have resulted in too many files. If you need a specific one, you can simply open the mod files, find the clothing texture you want, and edit it in Photoshop or any other image editor to match your preferred skin tone.

* - 4, but one of them has 4 variations, so there are 7 presets in total.
